QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_65

question.text: A Benchmarking Agency can be notified by any AIF association representing at LEAST what share of AIFs?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 230 of the workbook, any AIF industry association representing at least 33% of the number of AIFs may notify one or more Benchmarking Agencies. The Trap: 10%, 25% and 51% are not the prescribed threshold under SEBI's benchmarking framework. Note: The same 33% industry-association threshold also appears at page 137 in the context of SEBI-endorsed valuation guidelines.
